Hi all,

Attaching the March snapshot for the leadership dashboard (PDF) and the raw latency-cost breakdown (CSV). This is the one I want us to use for next week's QBR dry run. High-level notes below — please skim and flag any items you want pulled into the exec deck.

Snapshot highlights:
- Latency: median P50 is stable at 38ms; P95 increased to 310ms on 3/2 due to a model rollout.
- Cost: unit cost up 7% month-over-month driven by burst padding on Dedicated pools; caching hit rate dropped ~4ppt.
- Uptime: 99.94% for the month; two short incidents on 3/02 (12m) and 3/04 (7m) both traced to autoscaler race conditions.
- Usage: API requests up 22% MoM; embeddings growth concentrated in two enterprise accounts.

Asks:
1) Markus — can you confirm whether the model rollout that spiked P95 is still pinned or auto-rollback enabled? If pinned, we should Surface a mitigation plan.
2) Laura — want a 2-slide summary for execs: "what happened" + "what we’ll do next" (include cost impact).
3) Grace — please coordinate with CS to confirm whether the two enterprise accounts with spikes need outreach before QBR.

Attachments: 2028-03-monthly-dashboard.pdf (application/pdf), latency-breakdown.csv (text/csv)

Thanks,
Tessa

Tessa — thanks for this. Quick notes inline.

On Tue, Mar 6, 2028 at 09:12 Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Snapshot highlights:
> - Latency: median P50 is stable at 38ms; P95 increased to 310ms on 3/2 due to a model rollout.

The spike on 3/2 was due to the L2-quantized variant we tried on Dedicated for throughput testing; that variant regresses on long-sequence tails. We auto-rollback was enabled but did not trigger because the regression metric was under the threshold for alpha traffic.

Action: I will push a quick config change to lower the regression trigger during rollouts for that model family. ETA: today EOD.

> - Cost: unit cost up 7% month-over-month driven by burst padding on Dedicated pools; caching hit rate dropped ~4ppt.

We saw a config mismatch: burst padding was set permissively during an internal test. I have a patch to tighten padding thresholds; will coordinate with infra to schedule the change in next maintenance window.

Markus
Senior Director, Serving Runtime
